title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.09044v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. translated_title: 经验之树：面向自进化智能体的层级化经验管理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.09044v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：持续的自我进化要求大语言模型智能体将环境交互转化为可靠且可复用的经验。现有方法通常细化个体轨迹或从相关轨迹中抽象共享知识，但其经验表示往往与底层推理过程脱节。这限制了反馈归因、跨任务迁移以及更新和检索效率，特别是在具有结果级反馈的复杂推理任务中。为克服这一局限，我们提出经验之树（ToE），一种结构化经验管理框架，将经验组织与LLM智能体的层级化推理过程对齐。具体而言，ToE将经验组织为共享的分析视角和推理路径树，其可靠性通过环境结果进行校准，以支持系统性更新、迁移和高效检索。
tldr: 本文提出经验之树（ToE）框架，通过将经验组织成与LLM智能体层级化推理过程对齐的共享树结构，解决了现有经验管理方法中反馈归因、跨任务迁移和更新检索效率低的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Tree-of-Experience (ToE) framework, which addresses issues of feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update/retrieval efficiency in existing experience management methods by organizing experiences into a shared tree structure aligned with the hierarchical reasoning process of LLM agents.
